retention.scope: Only formerly referenced owned blobs after successful checkpoint/journal publication; current, backup, both catalog roots, corrupt/foreign-owner/link/unrelated preservation. No global cache sweep or concurrent whole-root quota claim.

video.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

limits: Only formerly referenced blobs; never arbitrary crash leftovers, unrelated files or other sessions.
Twelve catalog entries plus rollback/current/backup references remain usable.
Existing512MiB root admission remains; no concurrent cross-process reservation guarantee.
Failed or corrupt ownership/catalog reads conservatively skip cleanup; a failed deletion does not invalidate the checkpoint.
